instruction: How does CSS specificity actually resolve?
output: Count (ids, classes/attrs/pseudo-classes, elements): `#nav .item` (1,1,0) beats `.a.b.c` (0,3,0) beats `div` (0,0,1); equal scores go to the later rule. Avoid `!important` — it breaks the cascade for everyone after you; raise specificity or restructure instead.

instruction: Why is box-sizing border-box the first line in every project?
output:
```css
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
```
Default content-box adds padding/border outside width, so `width: 50%` + padding overflows. Border-box includes them — layouts become predictable. Set once globally, never think about it again.

instruction: CSS position: when relative, absolute, fixed, sticky?
output: relative nudges in place (and anchors absolute children); absolute positions against the nearest positioned ancestor; fixed pins to viewport (navbars); sticky switches relative-to-fixed on scroll (table headers). Absolute without a positioned ancestor escapes to the page — the classic lost-tooltip bug.

instruction: How do CSS variables theme a site?
Why is my z-index ignored (stacking contexts)?
output: `z-index` only competes within its stacking context — `opacity < 1`, `transform`, `filter` and `position: fixed` all spawn new ones, trapping huge z-indexes inside. Fix by lifting the element out of the transformed ancestor or removing the context-creating property, not by adding more nines.

instruction: Why do margins collapse in CSS?
output: Margin menegak bersebelahan bergabung ambil yang terbesar (`20px` + `30px` = `30px`, bukan 50) — reka bentuk, bukan pepijat. Elak kekeliruan dengan satu arah margin sahaja (margin-bottom) dalam komponen, atau `display: flow-root`/`flex`/`grid` pada induk yang menghalang runtuh.

output:
```css
.avatar { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; }
```
`border-radius: 50%` pada segi empat sama = bulatan; `object-fit: cover` potong gambar kemas (macam background-size untuk img). Pill: radius separuh ketinggian.

```css
.kad { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .08), 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / .12); }
```
Lapis dua bayang (tajam dekat + lembut jauh) nampak semula jadi; koma pisahkan lapisan. Bayang besar animasikan via `opacity` pseudo-elemen, bukan box-shadow terus (mahal).

```css
.hero { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #7c3aed); }
```
Sudut + dua henti minimum; tambah henti tengah untuk peralihan kaya. `radial-gradient(circle, ...)` untuk cahaya; `repeating-linear-gradient` untuk jalur. Uji kontras teks di atasnya.

instruction: How does object-fit work for images?
output: `cover` isi bingkai (potong lebihan, nisbah kekal) untuk hero/avatar; `contain` muat penuh (berbingkai); `fill` regang herot. Pasang dengan width/height tetap — tanpa dimensi, object-fit tiada kesan. Pasangannya: `object-position` kawal titik fokus potongan.

```css
.video { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; width: 100%; }
```
Ganti trik padding-top 56.25% — nisbah kekal walau lebar berubah, elak lompatan susun atur (CLS). Untuk gambar: tetapkan width + aspect-ratio, tinggi auto ikut.

instruction: How does clamp() give fluid type?
output:
```css
h1 { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw + 1rem, 3rem); }
```
`clamp(min, ideal, max)` — saiz mengikut viewport antara had; tiada media query untuk skala asas. Uji ekstrem (320px dan 4K) — formula buta pecah di hujung.
